capabilities.foundly_current: KPI registry, incremental cache, SSE, permission-partitioned event rollups and bounded historical pagination are tested. The actual page loader now supports Analysis-only composition and partial capabilities without requiring Automation; optional failures and disabled components are explicit. Event-stream connection state is distinct from successful HTTP loading. Explicit source-scoped observed retention cohorts now expose definition, interval bounds, unique membership, partial-window nulls and provenance, with private-event and encrypted restart tests. Source queries now filter relevant authorized records before copying and reject count/byte overflow without partial reports; a 50,000-excluded-row fixture verifies bounded copying. Owned, typed cohort definitions now support explicit save/load and revision-bound recalculation using current caller rights, with retained export and encrypted restart. Existing Analysis cohort definitions now retain immutable typed revision snapshots in the same atomic native save transaction. Explicit version and restore actions bind the current revision, reason and exact durable request receipt; restore creates a new revision and never runs an analysis or workflow. Current parent access governs history/list/detail/export after reassignment, with retained export after module disablement. Existing records without history capture only the genuinely retained baseline at its observed upgrade time, without inventing earlier revisions. Bounded history pages, original snapshots, malformed/foreign/corrupted source denial, atomic rollback, lost-response replay and encrypted restart are tested. Production cohort controls now expose typed revision editing and separate restore confirmation; synthetic DOM tests cover literal snapshots, unsaved input, changed/detached views, current read-only rights and retries. Real-member HTTP tests include role revocation during body waits and exact query-revision behavior. CI 121 passed the prior Sales ZERO checkpoint. Phase 24 remains active: broader configurable Analysis models, source drilldowns, multi-scope load and the explicit approved-action/outcome loop are still code-controlled work, followed by other recorded module gaps. No actual browser/provider/production or comparative acceptance is inferred. Analysis now supports explicitly typed saved event-count, source-namespaced distinct-identity and integer minor-unit currency measures, with source/event/campaign/provider filters and up to two grouping fields. These models reuse the native definition version/history/restore workflow and current canonical-event policy. No formulas, arbitrary code, inferred identity joins, mixed-currency totals, missing-value coercion or partial capacity results are accepted. Group and source pages bind exact current model revision and selected source fingerprints; changes or revoked access require recalculation. The new native field projection avoids unused/private payload copies and supports bounded larger selections while preserving the prior projection contract. Production model creation, calculation, shared typed revision editing and source drilldown controls are tested through actual services; unchanged capability refreshes preserve unsaved input and current read-only/event/report gates remain separate. Real-member HTTP fixtures prove independent source scopes, body-wait model reassignment, encrypted restart and native revision restore. The large fixture covers 110001 retained events, 16 distinct current scopes of 2000 events each, and a separate 30001-event selection, with zero unused/private payload reads and no partial result beyond the 100000 selected-record limit. The full-regression measured timings are recorded separately and are not production/browser or universal performance acceptance. CI 122 passed the prior history checkpoint. Phase 24 continues with the recorded Analysis approved-action/current-outcome loop and other remaining module gaps; no provider completeness, causality, production or competitive-superiority claim is made.
capabilities.gap: Typed configurable models, source/group drilldowns and native revision history have local evidence. Actual browser and measured competitive breadth/acceptance remain unproven; no provider coverage or causal claim is inferred.
capabilities.required_change: Preserve typed native model/source contracts while completing the recorded action/outcome loop and remaining module/browser/comparative acceptance.
capabilities.foundly_differentiator: Candidate: shared Core identity, provenance and ZERO tools. Comparative superiority is not proven.
